map.液压油清洁度等级判定 使用指南: Hydraulic Oil Cleanliness Grade Judgement User Guide
map.输入油液颗粒计数器检测结果（每100mL油液中各粒径范围的颗粒数），自动判定 I: Enter particle counter results for the oil (particle counts per 100mL in each size range); the tool automatically determines ISO 4406 and NAS 1638 cleanliness grades and suggests suitable applications.
map.ISO 4406：对 ≥4μm(c)、≥6μm(c)、≥14μm(c) 三档颗粒: ISO 4406: look up the code tables for particle counts at ≥4μm(c), ≥6μm(c) and ≥14μm(c) to get c4/c6/c14, output as "c4/c6/c14"; NAS 1638: look up the grade for each of the five size bands 5-15, 15-25, 25-50, 50-100 and >100μm, and take the highest grade among the bands as the final NAS grade
map.油液清洁度按两种标准判定。ISO 4406 采用累加计数：对三个粒径档（≥4μm: Oil cleanliness is judged under two standards. ISO 4406 uses cumulative counts: look up the code table for each of three size bands (≥4μm(c), ≥6μm(c), ≥14μm(c)), where a particle count falling in a range gives the corresponding code, and output it as "4/6/14", usually judged mainly by the ≥6μm code; NAS 1638 looks up a limit table for five size ranges and takes the worst (highest) grade as the system cleanliness grade. Lower grades are cleaner, and servo systems generally require ISO ≤16.
map.按颗粒计数定 ISO 4406 等级。: Determine the ISO 4406 grade from particle counts.
map.伺服比例阀系统要求更高清洁度。: Servo proportional valve systems require higher cleanliness.
map.：≥4μm 250000 颗/mL、≥6μm 32000、≥14μm 4000: : ≥4μm 250000 particles/mL, ≥6μm 32000, ≥14μm 4000 → ISO 4406 code about 21/19/16, requiring fine filtration to comply.
map.：伺服系统要求 15/13/11，现等级偏高需加 β 滤芯与离线过滤。: : servo systems require 15/13/11; the current grade is too high, so a β filter element and offline filtration are needed.
map.三个数分别代表 ≥4/6/14μm 的等级代码（每级约 2 倍颗粒数），越小越干: The three numbers are the grade codes for ≥4/6/14μm (each step is about a doubling in particle count); the smaller the numbers the cleaner the oil.
map.为什么伺服阀要求高？: Why do servo valves demand such high cleanliness?
map.伺服阀间隙微米级，颗粒易卡滞磨损，故清洁度要求严。: Servo valve clearances are on the micrometre scale, where particles easily jam and wear, so cleanliness demands are strict.
